title: Perception & Illusions Adventure
welcome_lead: Sometimes your eyes tell lies. Welcome to illusions. 👀
meta_desc: Emotion & Perception Adventure 2 — KS3 Psychology on perception and visual illusions.
final_note: You learned how perception works and why illusions trick the brain.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Sensation is the raw data — light, sound, smell.

Perception is what your brain decides it means.

Same shape can be a 'B' or '13' — depending on context.

Bottom-up — just the data.

Top-down — brain guesses using past experience.

That's why you read 'th_ ca_' as 'the cat' — your brain fills gaps.

Illusions trick the brain.

  • The Müller-Lyer arrows — two equal lines look different.
  • The 'rabbit-or-duck' image — your brain flips between them.

Illusions show perception is a brain process, not just eyesight. 🦆
